title: "A-2 camera" – U-2 reconnaissance camera assembly photo (Chapter 2, p. 52)
description: Dark black-and-white photograph captioned "A-2 camera," showing a camera assembly and mounting frame with lenses and framework faintly visible. The text discusses the Perkin-Elmer tracking camera and backup K-17 trimetrogon system carried with the A-1, and James Baker's computer-aided lens design for the next generation of cameras.
